items.title: I was just in Alaska launching the largest Energy Infrastructure Project in Alaska History— The Alaska LNG Project. This 50 Billion Dollar Infrastructure Investment from The Republic of Korea is part of their Trade and Investment Deal with me. I am also announcing today that my Commerce Secretary, Howard Lutnick, has secured an Offtake Commitment from Taiwan of between 70 to 80 Billion Dollars for Alaska LNG — That is 30% of the Pipeline for the next 20 years. This is the largest Offtake Agreement in History. On top of that, Taiwan has also agreed to Invest 4.4 Billion Dollars in Equity into the Project, because this is now a U.S. Federal Government Project, with all necessary permits secured, and all necessary authorizations delivered, and ready to go. This is the GREATEST Project in Alaska History, and this only happens with me in the White House. Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP
